verses.text: וַיּ֨וֹשַׁע יְהֹוָ֜ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֛וּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיַּ֤רְא יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵ֖ת עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיָּֽם:
וַיַּ֨רְא יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־הַיָּ֣ד הַגְּדֹלָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיַּֽאֲמִ֙ינוּ֙ בַּֽיהֹוָ֔ה וּבְמֹשֶׁ֖ה עַבְדּֽוֹ:
אָ֣ז יָשִֽׁיר־מֹשֶׁה֩ וּבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אָשִׁ֤ירָה לַֽיהֹוָה֙ כִּֽי־גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְב֖וֹ רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם:
עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֔הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה זֶ֤ה אֵלִי֙ וְאַנְוֵ֔הוּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י אָבִ֖י וַאֲרֹמְמֶֽנְהוּ:
מַרְכְּבֹ֥ת פַּרְעֹ֛ה וְחֵיל֖וֹ יָרָ֣ה בַיָּ֑ם וּמִבְחַ֥ר שָֽׁלִשָׁ֖יו טֻבְּע֥וּ בְיַם־סֽוּף:
יְמִֽינְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֔ה נֶאְדָּרִ֖י בַּכֹּ֑חַ יְמִֽינְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֖ה תִּרְעַ֥ץ אוֹיֵֽב:
וּבְרֹ֥ב גְּאוֹנְךָ֖ תַּהֲרֹ֣ס קָמֶ֑יךָ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ חֲרֹ֣נְךָ֔ יֹאכְלֵ֖מוֹ כַּקַּֽשׁ:
וּבְר֤וּחַ אַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ נֶ֣עֶרְמוּ מַ֔יִם נִצְּב֥וּ כְמוֹ־נֵ֖ד נֹזְלִ֑ים קָֽפְא֥וּ תְהֹמֹ֖ת בְּלֶב־יָֽם:

observations: I read all five images (s88-b0 to b3 and the full page s88.jpg) and transcribed them before opening primary-frozen.json.

The only tool available was Read, so I could not crop, zoom or enhance the images. The b-crops are about 1.1–1.3× and the full page was downscaled (1368×2264 shown at 1208×2000). Small accent shapes are at the limit of what can be resolved: qadma vs geresh, munach vs mahpakh, revia vs pashta position, meteg vs sublinear accent, and dagesh/mappiq dots.

Caveat on independence: even reading from the image, a reader who knows the Masoretic text tends to see the expected mark when a sign is faint. I did not consult any other edition or OCR, but treat every pending_human item as truly unresolved, not as a soft agreement.

Most of Exod 14:30 and 15:1–8 agrees with the primary accent by accent. The main conflict is the first clause of Exod 14:31 (four consecutive words), plus the first mark on וַיַּֽאֲמִינוּ. A human should check that clause against the physical scan at higher magnification.
Margin notes on the page: 'שמות' plus chapter marker 'י״ד' beside 14:30, and 'שמות' plus 'ט״ו' beside 15:1. These are not part of the verse text.
From 15:1 the Song is set in the brick-on-brick layout with wide internal gaps. Those gaps are not represented in the text above.
The page ends with the single word אָמַ֥ר (merkha under מ seems visible), the start of Exod 15:9. Transcription stops there.
